description: This PHP class 'ScreenDao' extends 'BaseDao' and provides a data access method 'getScreen' to retrieve a Screen entity based on a specified module name and action URL. It constructs a query using Doctrine's QueryBuilder to perform a left join between the 'Screen' entity and its 'module' relation, filtering by the given parameters.

classes.name: ScreenDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for performing database operations related to 'Screen' entities, including retrieving screens based on module and action.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves a 'Screen' entity corresponding to the given module name and action URL by constructing and executing a Doctrine query.
